intent: INDEX routing matches whole path segments, not text inside other file names
notes: A plain `INDEX.md` token matched anywhere in a path, so `gator_core.py` also claimed `tests/test_gator_core.py`, and a test-only change needed a Core Library charter edit or an Architect approval (#112). It blocked the #104 commit.

A plain token now matches only on whole path segments: the path equals it, ends with `/<token>`, or starts with `<token>/`. Bare file names still match their files wherever they live, and globs are unchanged. On this repository only six test files lose a route, and no source file's route changes.
The same routing decides ownership for the new-function warning, so a test can no longer count as an importer owned by another charter. Both hook copies change together.
